# AppDimens — Documentation Hub

> AppDimens is a multi-platform family of responsive sizing libraries that replaces fragile `dp` / `sp` / `pt` / `px` with explicit, perceptual scaling kernels. The same vocabulary (BALANCED, DEFAULT, PERCENTAGE, …) and the same math travel across Android (Jetpack Compose + XML), .NET for Android / MAUI, Apple (iOS / macOS), Kotlin Multiplatform, Flutter, React Native and the Web. This repository is the **documentation hub**: it publishes the shared vocabulary, the mathematical theory of every scaling kernel, cross-platform API mapping and migration paths. Each platform implementation ships from its own GitHub repository (included here as Git submodules) with its own semver, install line and changelog — the hub never pins versions.

## Platform repositories (submodules)

- [appdimens-dynamic](https://github.com/bodenberg/appdimens-dynamic) — Android runtime kernels, **3.1.9**, Production — [LLMS.txt](https://github.com/bodenberg/appdimens-dynamic/blob/main/LLMS.txt)
- [appdimens-sdps](https://github.com/bodenberg/appdimens-sdps) — Android XML `@dimen` SDP-style resources, **3.1.7**, Production — [LLMS.txt](https://github.com/bodenberg/appdimens-sdps/blob/main/LLMS.txt)
- [appdimens-ssps](https://github.com/bodenberg/appdimens-ssps) — Android XML SSP-style text resources, **3.1.7**, Production
- [appdimens-kmp](https://github.com/bodenberg/appdimens-kmp) — Kotlin Multiplatform, **1.0.1**, Production — [LLMS.txt](https://github.com/bodenberg/appdimens-kmp/blob/main/LLMS.txt)
- [appdimens-net-binding](https://github.com/bodenberg/appdimens-net-binding) — .NET 10 for Android / MAUI NuGet bindings, **3.5.1.4**, Production
- [appdimens-ios](https://github.com/bodenberg/appdimens-ios) — Apple UIKit + SwiftUI + Metal, **3.1.6**
- [appdimens-flutter](https://github.com/bodenberg/appdimens-flutter) — Flutter (Android / iOS / Web / desktop)
- [appdimens-react-native](https://github.com/bodenberg/appdimens-react-native) — React Native (iOS & Android)
- [appdimens-web](https://github.com/bodenberg/appdimens-web) — Web (vanilla / React / Vue / Svelte / Angular)
- [appdimens-games](https://github.com/bodenberg/appdimens-games) — Android game / NDK sizing helpers

## Scaling strategies (the 14 kernels)

- [Scaled (default)](https://github.com/bodenberg/appdimens-dynamic/blob/main/DOCUMENTATION/scaled.md) — linear SDP-style baseline
- [Auto](https://github.com/bodenberg/appdimens-dynamic/blob/main/DOCUMENTATION/auto.md) — hybrid linear + logarithmic (BALANCED, recommended)
- [Percent](https://github.com/bodenberg/appdimens-dynamic/blob/main/DOCUMENTATION/percent.md) — axis-heavy proportional scaling
- [Power](https://github.com/bodenberg/appdimens-dynamic/blob/main/DOCUMENTATION/power.md) — Stevens-style sublinear curve
- [Logarithmic](https://github.com/bodenberg/appdimens-dynamic/blob/main/DOCUMENTATION/logarithmic.md) — Weber–Fechner damping for large screens
- [Fluid](https://github.com/bodenberg/appdimens-dynamic/blob/main/DOCUMENTATION/fluid.md) — clamp band (CSS `clamp()`-like)
- [Interpolated](https://github.com/bodenberg/appdimens-dynamic/blob/main/DOCUMENTATION/interpolated.md) — fixed–linear blend
- [Diagonal](https://github.com/bodenberg/appdimens-dynamic/blob/main/DOCUMENTATION/diagonal.md) — Euclidean diagonal scaling
- [Perimeter](https://github.com/bodenberg/appdimens-dynamic/blob/main/DOCUMENTATION/perimeter.md) — W + H perimeter scaling
- [Fit](https://github.com/bodenberg/appdimens-dynamic/blob/main/DOCUMENTATION/fit.md) — letterbox (contain)
- [Fill](https://github.com/bodenberg/appdimens-dynamic/blob/main/DOCUMENTATION/fill.md) — cover
- [Density](https://github.com/bodenberg/appdimens-dynamic/blob/main/DOCUMENTATION/density.md) — DPI-bucket scaling
- [Resize](https://github.com/bodenberg/appdimens-dynamic/blob/main/DOCUMENTATION/resize.md) — constraint-based auto-fit
- [Physical units](https://github.com/bodenberg/appdimens-dynamic/blob/main/DOCUMENTATION/physical-units.md) — real-world mm / cm / inch

## Key concepts

- **Hub label** — stack-neutral name (BALANCED, DEFAULT, PERCENTAGE, DYNAMIC) mapped to each platform's tokens.
- **Kernel** — the one-dimensional map `f_S(b, c)` turning a base value `b` into an output given a `Configuration` `c`.
- **`auto` / BALANCED** — linear below 480 dp, logarithmic above (hinge constant 480 dp, ln gain 0.4).
- **`scaled` / DEFAULT** — linear-proportional anchored at 300 dp.
- **Aspect-ratio suffix `a`** — optional AR multiplier referenced to 16:9 (1.78).
- **Inverters (`*Ph`, `*Lw`, `*Lh`)** — swap the driving axis on rotation.
- **Two operating tracks** — runtime computation (dynamic, iOS, KMP, Flutter, RN, Web) and pre-computed `@dimen` resources (sdps, ssps); you can mix both.

## Documentation format

- The hub `DOCS/` folder is **theory-only** — no semver, no install lines. The submodule READMEs are the source of truth for versions and APIs.
- When prose in the hub disagrees with a submodule, the submodule wins.
- Math renders with GitHub's KaTeX subset; the canonical reference is `appdimens-dynamic/DOCUMENTATION/MATHEMATICS-AND-CALCULUS.md`.
